parole.significato: paw of a large predator, especially felines
parole.testo: From Middle High German pranke, a Romance borrowing, found as Late Latin branca, from Gaulish.

From Middle High German tant (“idle talk, tricks”), of unclear origin, possibly a Romance borrowing, compare Spanish tanto (“purchase price”, literally “so much”). Cognate with Bavarian Tand, Danish tant, Norwegian Bokmål tant.
